media_qa.scope: Whole-file encoding, black/freeze and audio checks; visual content, type and cut boundaries sampled separately. Caption sidecars were subsequently realigned and independently audited, superseding the earlier caption summary. No human-by-ear or physical-phone audit.

subtitles.method: Ordered script/ASR unit edit alignment with explicit number, compound and proper-name normalization; exact script retained. Cue starts lead ASR anchors by 50ms. Known synthesis starts replace implausible scene-first ASR anchors. Dynamic-programming reflow enforces two lines, 42 chars/line, no overlaps and <=19.5 CPS; no proportional fallback for unmatched words.
subtitles.scope: Independent local ASR plus trusted synthesis scene starts, followed by a separate reviewer. Uncertain name spellings and scene-start ASR timing are disclosed. This is not human listening or a physical-player perceptual sync test.
